escenas.texto: We toured Oceania, Asia, Africa, Europe and the Americas. Now, the ranking that brings it all together: this week's global Top 10. This week in the World, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over six hundred and seventy-nine million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, the World edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The world rules: the top three of every list from every continent compete here, the same videos and the same numbers from this Sunday's world tour. One video per creator on each list. Every number comes from the official YouTube API. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Coming in at number ten, from Egypt, Omar kotb, with a video posted three days ago. Over eighteen million views. A Short of just nineteen seconds. It also has over eighty-seven thousand likes.
Number nine, from Türkiye, Mr Spring, with “Did GTA 6 Finally Fix BLOCKED Car Doors?”. Over nineteen million views. A Short of just thirty-six seconds. It also has over three thousand comments.
Next up, number eight, from South Korea, RESCENE, with a video posted four days ago. Over nineteen million views. A Short of just ten seconds. It also has over one thousand comments.
Next up, number seven, from India, Maddock Films, with “Sisuse me!!! Shraddha Kapoor Eetha in cinemas 4th December”. Over twenty-seven million views. It also has over one thousand comments.
Next up, number six, SEEDPIT Official, with “Kevin says Seed is TOO SMALL”. Over twenty-eight million views. A Short of just thirty-nine seconds. It also has four hundred and one comments.

Number five, Goodluck Amarachi Yusuf, with “Our new pediatrician taught me this”. Over thirty-one million views. And get this: it's a channel with about thirteen thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eighteen seconds.

Coming in at number four, from United States, VerrTV, with “Couch Glitch For New GTA”. Over thirty-four million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and ten thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just twenty-one seconds.

Bronze medal, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “My first day in vice city gta 6 gameplay”. Over thirty-six million views. A video over one hundred and twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over fifty-four thousand comments.

Silver medal, from United States, Marvel Entertainment, with “Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer In Theaters December 18”. Over fifty million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one million views per hour. It has the best engagement rate on this list: three out of every hundred viewers liked or commented.

And here it is. Number one most viewed, from United States, MrBeast Gaming, with “I Survived 100 Hours In GTA 6”. Over seventy-two million views. A video over thirty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over seventeen thousand comments.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. At number ten, from Kenya, Bahati Kenya, with a video posted five days ago. Over eight thousand comments. It also has over three point one million views.

At number nine, from United Kingdom, IAmBeanz, with “GTA 6 Feels Like Something's Off...”. Over nine thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over one point six million views.
At number eight, from France, Ninjaxx, with a video posted five days ago. Over thirteen thousand comments. It also has over one point three million views.

In position number seven, from India, Shivang Mini, with a video posted one day ago. Over fourteen thousand comments. A video over twenty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.

In position number six, HYPNOS CR, with a video posted two days ago. Over sixteen thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: twenty-four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over thirty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.
Coming in at number five, from Japan, なにわ男子, with a video posted three days ago. Over twenty thousand comments. It also has over one point four million views.
In position number four, from United States, Asmongold TV , with “The GTA 6 backlash is getting out of hand..”. Over twenty-seven thousand comments. It also has over five point one million views.
Bronze medal, from United States, skibidi, with “skibidi toilet 83 part 2”. Over forty-one thousand comments. It also has over nine point three million views.

Silver medal, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “My first day in vice city gta 6 gameplay”. Over fifty-four thousand comments. A video over one hundred and twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over thirty-six million views.

And finally, number one most commented, from United States, Marvel Entertainment, with “Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer In Theaters December 18”. Over ninety-two thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one million views per hour. It got there in just two days.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. In position number ten, Bloxy Productions, with “Why You Exist.”. Over one hundred and seventy-seven thousand likes. It also has over three point seven million views.

Number nine, from United Kingdom, Mat Armstrong MK2, with “Attempting to fix the misfiring bugatti chiron”. Over one hundred and ninety-seven thousand likes. A video over forty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

Number eight, from India, resham info, with a video posted five days ago. Over two hundred and sixty-seven thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about forty-seven thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over eight point three million views.

Coming in at number seven, PORTIA AI STORY LITH , with a video posted two days ago. Over two hundred and ninety-eight thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: five out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. It got there in just two days.

Next up, number six, from Türkiye, Mr Spring, with “Did GTA 6 Finally Fix BLOCKED Car Doors?”. Over three hundred and three thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-six seconds. It also has over nineteen million views.
Number five, from India, Aman Sharma , with a video posted five days ago. Over three hundred and thirteen thousand likes. It also has over nine point two million views.

Number four, from United States, MrBeast, with “Can I Beat Magnus Carlsen?”. Over six hundred and thirty-three thousand likes. A Short of just thirty-nine seconds. It also has over twenty million views.

Bronze medal, from United States, MrBeast Gaming, with “I Survived 100 Hours In GTA 6”. Over seven hundred and seventy-four thousand likes. A video over thirty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over seventy-two million views.

Silver medal, from India, Techno Gamerz, with “My first day in vice city gta 6 gameplay”. Over one million likes. A video over one hundred and twenty-seven minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over thirty-six million views.

And here it is. Number one most liked, from United States, Marvel Entertainment, with “Avengers: Doomsday Final Trailer In Theaters December 18”. Over one point five million likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about one million views per hour. It got there in just two days.

And that wraps up this week's world tour. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday. And a question for you: do you want us to hold a real award for the Top 10 winners? If you do, write the hashtag Premios Top 10 RS in the comments, all in one word.
